I didn’t feel any palpitations or dizziness, just the lightheadedness and trouble breathing. I don’t have a family history of heart disease, and I don’t have any other significant medical conditions. Doctor: Could you describe the nature of the chest pain you experienced during the bike ride? Was it sharp, dull, pressure-like, or something else? Also, did you notice any radiation of the pain to other areas, such as your arm, neck, or jaw? Patient: The chest pain was more of a mild discomfort, not really sharp or pressure-like, and it didn't radiate anywhere else.
